snippet.title: Windswept ► Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Coming November 11th!

Marbles and Checkers were swept away by a storm and they need your help finding their way home! Play as a tag-team Duck & Turtle duo by yourself or grab a friend for real-time local co-op in this 90s platforming adventure. Traverse a huge world spanning 5 regions with over 40 hand-crafted stages, and meet a colorful cast of friends (and foes!) along the way. In this beautiful, cute 2D world, there's a ton of stuff to do and even more to collect. Inspired by classic titles such as Donkey Kong Country, Windswept aims to be a precision platformer embodying the best of the genre. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1660960/Windswept/
